c: CI dependency view and Service dependency view show what the CI depends on and what depends on it.
say: In the workspace, the dependency views beside the CI and service fields show what depends on what.

c: Affected CIs lists what the ticket touches; its own CI is added for you.
say: Affected CIs lists what the ticket touches. Its own CI is added for you.
Impacted services lists the services that are hit.

c: On a change it is refreshed from the affected CIs.
say: On a change, it is refreshed from the affected CIs.

c: On an incident use Refresh Impacted Services, which leaves the affected CIs out.
say: On an incident, use refresh impacted services in the form menu. It leaves the affected CIs out.
